objective: Prioritize National Outdoor Tools toward a long-range target of 1,000,000 Google Search impressions per day without weakening existing source, canonical, or search-quality governance.

relationshipToExistingGovernance.rule: Scale Score does not authorize a build or an indexable route. Existing hard vetoes, source/loss gates, canonical rules, location-admission rules, and production benchmark remain controlling.

interpretation.below-80: destination/niche/supporting value unless other evidence changes

scaleScore.note: Scores are strategic prioritization estimates, not keyword-volume or traffic forecasts. Re-score with Search Console and post-launch analytics.

recommendedSequence.rule: Deepen and measure existing anchors while prototyping one new scalable family at a time.

engines.name: River Conditions & Forecast
engines.nextMove: Deepen current Rivers with rain/NWPS context; migrate fully to modern USGS APIs.

engines.name: Coastal Water Window
engines.nextMove: Production-verified; expand by meaningful coastal regions/places, not keyword permutations.

engines.name: Smoke / Clear-Air Window
engines.nextMove: Very large surface; unblock AirNow/FIRMS configuration before indexable launch.

engines.name: National Park Conditions Desk
engines.nextMove: Park-by-park decision pages from NPS alerts + NWS + activity-specific conditions.

engines.name: Paddling Conditions Window
engines.nextMove: Activity lens from wind, precip, flow/waves, temp and warnings; no universal safety score.

engines.name: Flood / High-Water Trip Impact

engines.name: Night Sky Clear/Dark Window

engines.name: Snowpack & Melt

engines.name: Aurora Visibility

engines.name: Planting Calendar

engines.name: Garden Water Stress
